_comment: Copy to rails.json and put YOUR plans here. The dollar figures below are illustrative.
engines: the names your own call log writes for this vendor. Two entries are common:
one for the vendor, one for its CLI. Getting this wrong is the bug that makes a live
rail print as zero calls and pushes you to cancel a plan you actually use.
usage_logs: JSONL files your tooling writes, at minimum {"ts": <epoch>, "engine": "..."}.
List every log. Reading only one of two copies once undercounted a rail by half.

rails.role: shell, code, mechanical work, second opinion
